checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', no extra text
must.why: Reads 'A quriter kind of morning.' — misspelled and with a trailing period.

must.item: Legible cream lettering on dark green card, inside frame
must.why: Cream serif text on dark green, centered and fully in frame.

must.item: Title card ~first 2 seconds then cut to lake
must.why: 0.6s is the title and 2.4s is the lake, consistent with a cut near 2s.

must.item: Misty mountain lake at sunrise with slow motion
must.why: Misty lake with mountains and warm sunrise glow. The trees move out of frame, which shows a slow camera push or drift.
Frames are 16:9 and the stated length is 6 s. Audio can't be checked from stills.

faults.what: Unrequested trailing period added to the title
The assistant's message claimed the clip was ready but did not say the title was misspelled. It only warned of possible errors in general.

summary: The lake shot is a good, slowly moving misty sunrise, but the title card is misspelled ('quriter') with an extra period, so the clip needs a redo.
